_comment: Packages allowed despite a license not on the deny.toml allowlist. Each entry needs a reason; devOnly entries must be dev dependencies (build/test tools, never shipped). Checked by scripts/check-npm-licenses.mjs. Approved by the project owner on 2026-11-21.

exceptions.reason: CSS transformer used by Vite 8 at build time. Not shipped; MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft and does not extend to the CSS it outputs.
